clue_officer_chan.title: Officer Chan's interview log
clue_officer_chan.content:
This log contains the interview record of Officer Chan.
Over the past three months, he arrested 40 people, 35 of whom were later proven innocent and released.
But he doesn't remember those 35 wrongful arrests.He only remembers the 5 correct ones. 


 “Last week I caught a wanted criminal using this system — it's very accurate!
